eval.title: APPLE STOCK ANALYSIS 2022 - A BUY, SELL or HOLD FOR YOU? (Valuation & Expected Returns)

call.headline_quote: i don't own it but it's a great business nothing wrong with it a little bit high valuation but the greatness of the business might be worth it might be worth it to pay a premium for such a good business

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: that is this hockey stick earnings per share for input so six dollars and three cents

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: for an expected 10 return with a terminal multiple so a price earnings ratio of 20 in 10 years then the intrinsic value is 100 per share

scenarios.name: best
scenarios.quote: if they grow 10 per year over the next five years eight percent over the subsequent five years 10 expected return and the key is that the current price earnings ratio of 28.7 doesn't change then if that all holds then you'll have a 10 return

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: after things turn south there is a lower terminal multiple then the present value is much much lower which is something i would call the risky margin of safety scenario

what_is_priced_in.quote: growth of five percent from the business current cash flows 100 billion or six dollars per share and four percent from continuation in buybacks because the buybacks increase the earnings per share because there is less and less stocks out there so total nine percent growth

reasons.claim: The base-case intrinsic value of 100 is well below the current market price, making valuation the key risk.
reasons.quote: the intrinsic value is 100 per share this is of course way below the current stock price

reasons.claim: High net margins and an ecosystem people pay a premium to stay in show strong pricing power and a durable moat.
reasons.quote: net income is 27.9 of revenue for the last quarter and this shows that apple is a great business that has strong pricing power and extremely high margins

reasons.claim: Massive buybacks shrink share count and add growth to earnings per share on top of business growth.
reasons.quote: four percent from continuation in buybacks because the buybacks increase the earnings per share because there is less and less stocks out there

reasons.claim: Fast-growing services revenue and a huge, still-growing installed device base give apple further growth ahead.

reasons.quote: if the market goes back to a p ratio of 15 then it will not be that good for apple but that's the risk and reward of investing in apple
